description.value: Sports Junkies is a sprawling two-storey new-and-used sporting goods store established in 1992, anchored in Mt. Pleasant between MEC and Sport Chek. Alongside new and used bike sales, they operate a dedicated Tech Shop offering a full range of bicycle mechanical services from flat repairs to complete tune-ups and hub overhauls. Touring cyclists will find a knowledgeable bike department staff and the ability to drop in for service consultations.

bike_parking_detail: 4 racks within 100m: stands (2 spaces) at 3m; stands (2 spaces) at 27m; stands (6 spaces) at 48m; stands (6 spaces) at 54m. Total: 16 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at sportsjunkies.com is fully accessible and confirms an active bike service department at 102 West Broadway. The /bike-services/ subpage lists a comprehensive menu of mechanical services (tune-ups, flat repair, wheel builds, drivetrain work, etc.) and explicitly invites drop-ins ('feel free to drop in'), confirming walk-in access; however, the site specifies 'next day service' requires an appointment, leaving same-day urgency ambiguous. No evidence for a floor pump, bike rentals, or other touring-specific amenities was found in the website content.
concerns: Website specifies 'next day service' requires a phone appointment, so same-day urgent repair capability is not confirmed.
This is a general multi-sport retailer, not a dedicated bike shop; bike service depth may vary by season or staffing.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Sports Junkies has a clearly active, dedicated bike service department with drop-in access and a full mechanical service menu, making it a useful stop for touring cyclists needing repairs in Vancouver.

wow_evidence: dedicated Tech Shop offering a full range of bicycle mechanical services from flat repairs to complete tune-ups and hub overhauls
